verdict.rationale: The evidence pack does not document any in-product AI that generates insights or suggestions from a user's compliance data. The closest material is the Drata MCP server and "Enable AI agents to interact with Drata," which let external AI agents act on Drata. That is a different capability from native in-app AI insights, so it earns no credit here.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product
